Summary
The letter appears to be a publication notice for a comic book titled "고초장군 곰동이" (The Hardship General Gom Dongi) by Kim Yihwan. It was printed and published in August and September 1948, respectively. The sender's address is listed as Apolo House, Chung District, Jongzi-dong, Seoul. The price of the comic book is 90 won. The tone is informative and straightforward, focusing on the publication details.
